name: Nara - Autonomous Red Teaming Agent
tagline: Four AI agents scan, plan and exploit vulnerabilities in a codebase inside an isolated container.

awards: Best Champion of Open Source w/ Featherless - Featherless
Neelbauer Agentic Revolution Award (NARA) - Alumni Prize

solution: A CLI orchestrates scanner, planner, exploiter and reporter agents using static analysers and local and hosted models against a sandboxed target.
demo_moment: Team-described: point it at a repo and watch an exploit succeed in the sandbox.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Champion of Open Source w/ Featherless - Featherless” and “Neelbauer Agentic Revolution Award (NARA) - Alumni Prize” among 223 submissions.
Runs attacks only in an isolated target.

lessons: Agentic offence needs a sandbox to be demo-safe.
